name: Pagination drops one-item last pages
description: A small pagination library miscounts pages in a single helper, so lists whose last page holds exactly one item lose that item.
taskPrompt: Users of our list views report that the very last item sometimes never shows up: with 11 items and a page size of 5 the pager only offers 2 pages, so item 11 is unreachable. A list with a single item also seems to show nothing useful. Please find the cause in the pager-kit library and fix it. Keep the existing public API and behaviour for everything else, and add a regression test next to the existing ones.
visibleAcceptance: Every item of a list is reachable by walking pages 1..totalPages
Lists whose last page holds exactly one item report the correct number of pages
Existing tests keep passing and a regression test is added
